description: This Java source file defines the AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel class, which provides a user interface panel for configuring XML code style settings specific to Android development within an IDE. It includes nested classes for handling different XML resource file types and their formatting options.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel
classes.description: Main panel class for configuring Android-specific XML code style settings, including nested classes for specific resource file types.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel.MyFileSpecificPanel
classes.description: Abstract base class for resource-specific code style configuration panels.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel.LayoutCodeStylePanel
classes.description: Panel for configuring layout XML file formatting options.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel.ManifestCodeStylePanel
classes.description: Panel for configuring AndroidManifest.xml formatting options.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel.ValueResourcesCodeStylePanel
classes.description: Panel for configuring value resource files and selectors formatting options.

classes.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel.OtherCodeStylePanel
classes.description: Panel for configuring other XML resource files formatting options.

methods.name: AndroidXmlCodeStylePanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the main panel and resource-specific sub-panels.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the current UI settings to the given CodeStyleSettings object.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Checks if the UI settings differ from the current CodeStyleSettings.

methods.name: resetImpl
methods.description: Resets UI components to reflect the current CodeStyleSettings.
